purpose: Teach: 趣向/営み/勤める/試聴/範疇/本位/比重/集英社

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店内の演出に趣向を凝らしましょう
lines.en: Let's put real thought into how we design the store atmosphere.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful opening. Collaborative tone—inviting input, not dictating. Steady pace with slight emphasis on 'thought.' Confident but not dismissive of the other person's ideas.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。毎日の営みを大事にしたお店作りをします
lines.en: Yes. We'll build the store with care for the everyday experiences customers have.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Measured pace showing he's absorbing what was said. Slight nod in the voice—agreement that lands genuinely, not just compliance. Warm undertone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員に長く勤めるキャリアパスを示しましょう
lines.en: And let's give our staff a clear career path—show them we're invested in keeping them here long-term.
lines.style: Instructional but not cold. Deliberate pacing on 'long-term.' Conviction that this matters. Slight lean forward energy—this is important, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の試聴会を関係者向けに開きます
lines.en: Yes. We'll hold listening events for the new products—get feedback directly from key stakeholders.
lines.style: Engaged confirmation. Picks up the thread smoothly. Practical, forward-moving tone. Slight brightening on 'events'—he's thinking through the logistics already.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 範疇外の依頼は丁寧にお断りしましょう
lines.en: When requests fall outside our scope, let's decline them courteously—that protects our integrity.
lines.style: Measured directive. Calm authority without harshness. Slight pause before 'courteously'—the point being precision and respect, not just saying no. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様本位のサービスを徹底します
lines.en: Understood. We'll prioritize customer-focused service in everything we do.
lines.style: Solid agreement. Shows he understands the principle beneath the directive. Steady, reliable tone. Closes the thought with quiet conviction—he's made a commitment to himself, not just the boss.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外事業の比重を上げていきましょう
lines.en: Let's increase our focus on international business—grow that part of the operation.
lines.style: Strategic shift in energy. Longer view now—looking outward and forward. Slight expansion in tone. Confident but not overreaching. This is the bigger picture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。集英社の漫画展示も検討します
lines.en: Yes. We'll explore collaborating with Shueisha on a manga exhibition as well.
lines.style: Final note, slightly brighter. He's already thinking creatively about how to expand. Smooth delivery—this feels like a natural next step, not an afterthought. Settling into place.
